title: 第八章 她原来是打算用这种方式羞辱他
slug: 恶毒雌性玩的花兽世大佬排队跪
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

恶雌用了什么手段。

是不是白天包扎时，那些草药里掺了催化发情的香料。

是不是又想看他难堪，想看他发着疯地求她。

无论如何，苍凛都不想承认，是恶雌先前几声似真似假令他脸红的叫唤，提前了他的易感期。

后来的事，和苍凛想的完全不一样。

姜枝没有继续折磨他，没有站在一边拿那种看好戏的眼神盯着他。

她散发着诱人的香气，笑盈盈地向他伸手，把他拉进了洞穴。

苍凛被蛊惑了。

在本能的趋势下，他们居然结合了。

但是，昨晚他是第一次，理智本来就碎得七七八八。

哪怕他再怎么克制，到了后面也早就不可能真的收得住。

他根本不知道自己有没有弄疼她。

苍凛不禁担心。

恶雌平时懒得很，娇气也是真的娇气。

昨晚却被他扣在怀里，最后连声音都软得不像样……那几声，比她先前佯装出来的，更委婉动听，更令苍凛把持不住。

因为是真的。

苍凛眼底一沉，手指也无声收紧了一点。

晨光很淡，从洞口透进来一点，刚好落在姜枝身上。

她睡着的时候比醒着时安静，脸颊带着酒意散尽后的薄粉，头发乱蓬蓬的但很香，有几缕蹭在他肩头，呼吸轻轻打在他胸口，软得不像话。

她领口半掩下露出的那一小片皮肤，靠近心口的位置，浮出了一道暗红色的纹路。

兽纹不深，却已经成形，像火星烫过后留下的烙痕，安安静静印在那里。

那是苍凛的印记。

真正结合之后，才会在雌性身上显出来的东西。

苍凛胸腔里极轻地动了一下，竟生出一点近乎酸甜的欢喜。

他一边忍不住去想，也许昨晚以后，她或许能把目光分一点给他，一边又清楚地知道，自己没有资格期待太多。

那一点刚冒头的欢喜，就这么和更深的心虚、忐忑拧在一起，压得他胸口发闷。

而下一瞬，怀里的人动了。

姜枝要醒了。

苍凛身体几不可察地绷了一下，连呼吸都放轻了。

他本该在她醒来之前收回手，装作什么都没发生，至少别让自己看起来像是在等她反应。

可他没有。

苍凛只是安静地看着她，心里乱得厉害。

Page (1/3)

What methods did the evil female use?

Is it possible that during the daytime bandage, those herbs were mixed with spices that stimulate estrus?

Do you want to see him embarrassed again, want to see him begging her like crazy?

No matter what, Cang Lin didn't want to admit that it was the evil female's previous calls that were both true and false that made him blush, which had advanced his susceptibility period.

What happened next was completely different from what Cang Lin thought.

Jiang Zhi did not continue to torture him, nor did she stand aside and stare at him like a good show.

Exuding an alluring fragrance, she reached out to him with a smile and pulled him into the cave.

Cang Lin was bewitched.

Under the instinctive trend, they actually combined.

However, last night was the first time for him, and his reason was shattered to pieces.

No matter how much he restrained himself, he would never be able to hold it back later.

He had no idea whether he had hurt her or not.

Cang Lin couldn't help but worry.

The evil female is usually very lazy, and her squeamishness is really squeamish.

Last night, she was held in his arms, and in the end even her voice was too soft to be decent... Those few voices were more tactful and sweet than the ones she had pretended to make before, which made Cang Lin unable to control herself.

Because it's true.

Cang Lin's eyes darkened, and his fingers tightened silently.

The morning light was very faint, coming in a little from the entrance of the cave, and just fell on Jiang Zhi.

She was quieter when she was asleep than when she was awake, her cheeks were lightly powdered after the alcohol had dissipated, her hair was messy but fragrant, a few strands were rubbing against his shoulders, and her breath hit his chest gently, so soft that it was unbelievable.

The small piece of skin exposed under her half-covered collar, near her heart, had a dark red line.

The animal pattern is not deep, but it has already taken shape, like the mark left by sparks, quietly imprinted there.

That's Cang Lin's mark.

Something that will only show up in the female after the true union.

Cang Lin's chest moved very slightly, and she felt a little joy that was almost sweet and sour.

While he couldn't help but think that maybe after last night, she might be able to give him some of her attention, he also knew clearly that he was not qualified to expect too much.

The joy that had just emerged was mixed with the deeper guilt and anxiety, making his chest feel tight.

And the next moment, the person in his arms moved.

Jiang Zhi is about to wake up.

Cang Lin's body tensed almost imperceptibly, and even his breathing became lighter.

He should have withdrawn his hand before she woke up and pretended that nothing happened, at least not making it look like he was waiting for her to react.

But he didn't.

Cang Lin just looked at her quietly, feeling very confused.
